title: Bengali Wedding Customs
summary: Hindu Bengali weddings include gaye holud (turmeric ceremony), the bride in a red Banarasi with shankha-pola bangles and the groom in a topor (headdress), shubho drishti (first look), mala bodol (garland exchange), sindoor daan and bou bhat (reception at the groom's home).
